verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents point-in-time recovery that 'rolls you back to any moment,' which covers restoring accidentally dropped or corrupted tables. There is no evidence of time-travel querying, meaning reading data as of a past timestamp without rolling back. Agent branches cover current production data, not historical states. Missing for 10: documented as-of/time-travel query syntax, details on retention window and restore granularity (per-table vs whole-cluster), in-depth recovery docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
